proof_roadmap: Canonical differential products obey the axioms; populated monomials give a lower dimension bound.
The quotient of the multi-magmatic algebra is reduced to ordered and then normal left-leaning products.
The rotation-correspondence encoding matches these products with populated monomials, proving matching dimensions and the isomorphism.
difficulty_reason: The current proof performs nested reductions in the multi-magmatic quotient: operation labels are sorted, factor degrees and root labels ordered, and leaf labels normalized using degree, right-normed length, leaf count and second-level factor induction. The labeled rotation correspondence then encodes the normal products as populated differential monomials to match upper and lower homogeneous dimensions. These simultaneous multi-operation reductions and the basis correspondence remain explicit in the counted proof, rather than being removed by citing the earlier single-operation theorem.
